hook.text: Boeing had the best engineers. VW had the best cars. Both failed because their cultures tolerated shortcuts.

buildup.text: Operations failures trace back to culture—pressure to hit targets, fear of speaking up, and tolerance of risk.

discovery.text: A culture that punishes bad news ensures bad news is hidden—until it becomes a catastrophe.

twist.text: Every post-mortem of major failures finds warning signs that were ignored, dismissed, or suppressed.

climax.text: Organizations that celebrate problem-finding over problem-hiding catch failures early when fixes are cheap.

punchline.text: A culture of silence is a culture of risk.

quiz.question: What does a culture that punishes bad news produce?
